title: InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.32504v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a serious competitor to gradient-boosted trees, predicting on a new table in a single forward pass by in-context learning. However, their attention is quadratic in the number of samples and features, which caps pretraining at small synthetic tables and forces inference on large ones to rely on chunking or subsampling. Row-compression models reduce the feature-wise cost, but only by discarding the cell-level representation, and remain quadratic in the number of samples. We introduce InducedTFM, which replaces both attention stages of a bidimensional TFM with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, preserving cell-level representations while making its cost linear in both samples and features. Under a training budget matched to a full-attention TabICLv2 reimplementation, InducedTFM matches its accuracy on TabArena and on a benchmark of larger datasets, and clearly outperforms a kernel

translated_title: InducedTFM：基于诱导注意力的次二次复杂度表格基础模型家族
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型已成为梯度提升树的强劲竞争对手，能够通过上下文学习在单次前向传播中完成对新表格的预测。然而，其注意力机制在样本数量和特征数量上均呈二次方复杂度，这使得预训练只能局限于小型合成表格，而对大型表格的推理不得不依赖分块或子采样。行压缩模型虽然降低了特征维度的计算成本，但代价是丢弃了单元格级别的表示，并且在样本数量上仍然保持二次方复杂度。我们提出了 InducedTFM，它使用 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力替换了二维表格基础模型的两个注意力阶段，在保留单元格级别表示的同时，使其计算成本在样本和特征两个维度上均为线性。在与全注意力 TabICLv2 重新实现相匹配的训练预算下，InducedTFM 在 TabArena 以及一个包含更大数据集的基准上达到了与其相当的准确率，并明显优于核方法基线。
tldr: 针对表格基础模型注意力机制随样本和特征数量呈二次方增长的计算瓶颈，本文提出 InducedTFM，用 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力替换二维注意力的两个阶段，在保留单元格级表示的同时将计算成本降为线性，并在与全注意力模型同等训练预算下取得相当的准确率。
en_tdlr: InducedTFM replaces both attention stages of tabular foundation models with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, reducing computational cost to linear in both samples and features while preserving cell-level representations, and matching full-attention accuracy under matched training budgets.
